# Raw samples for gate G2 (generated by scripts/make_raw_samples.py)

Read these before trusting the aggregates. For each incident, ask: are these reports about the same intrusion or campaign wave? Mark any that look wrong; the incidents are in results/attack_clusters_main.json and results/corpus_clusters_main.json.

## QA and exclusion rates

- ATT&CK: 1,936 cited reports, 1,839 dated (95%); 1,428 incidents; 810 reports in 302 multi-report incidents; largest 12 reports.
- ATT&CK techniques: 619 seen, 215 tested (20+ report mentions); 404 excluded from the significance tests as too rare.
- Report texts: 3,775 texts, 532 with 3+ explicit technique IDs (the rest are used only for clustering and validation); 41 multi-report incidents among the labelled texts.
- TIE: 6,025 entries, 5,442 incidents; most entries are undated and cannot be linked (see paper, Sect. 3).
- Producer: ATT&CK 345 vendors, 10 reports without a URL; texts 188 vendors, 177 texts without a URL.
